test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

ORGANS, SORGAN, SNORGA, ?, SNAGOR, SNAGRO
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

 
• **Last letter is shifted to first position , then again last letter is shifted to second position and so on.**

**​**So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ae5cc18a0386cdcb1796077aad5d601856f8f4f4b91ab10e3cb21b9ccb1c23.png] 

Hence, **"SNAORG"** is the correct answer.
